parse.title: Pay-to-play Melee training
parse.wikitext:
===Levels 30 to 50: Crabs===
{{Melee training monster
|name = [[Gemstone Crab]]
|locations = [[Tlati Rainforest]]
|combat = 160
|hitpoints = Infinite
|requirements = [[Children of the Sun]]
|recommendations = Gear required for looting if one of the top 16 damage dealers:
*[[Pickaxe]] to mine for gems.
*[[Chisel]] to cut and fletch semi-precious gems.
*[[Gem bag]] for storing gem drops.
|advantages = 
*The best monster for training at medium and high combat levels.
*Has infinite health with low [[Defence]] and [[Attack]] ability, meaning you won't need much food if any
*Can be mined for gems by the 16 players who dealt the most damage.
|disadvantages =
*Switches locations after 10 minutes; must be pursued by entering a nearby cave.
*Gives slightly less experience per hit compared to normal monsters (87.5% of the normal amount), though this is made up for by the fact there is no downtime between killing monsters as there is with the other crabs.
}}

{{Melee training monster
|name = [[Ammonite Crab]]
|locations = [[Fossil Island]]
|combat = 25
|hitpoints = 100
|requirements = [[Bone Voyage]]
|recommendations = Armour and food for low defence levels. [[Digsite pendant]]. Build the bank chest on Fossil Island to get access to a nearby bank. [[Ring of wealth]] to automatically pick up [[numulite]]s.
|advantages = 
*Very high health targets with low [[Defence]] and [[Attack]] ability, meaning you won't need much food if any
*High in number, easy to group and kill in groups
*Automatic aggro, meaning there are many AFK spots
|disadvantages = * Often crowded
*Stops aggro after 10 minutes. Must be reset by walking away and coming back. The distance required to reset their aggro status fluctuates but usually stays between 1 and 15 tiles. There are instances where it is further away
}}

{{Melee training monster
|name = [[Sand Crab]]
|locations = Beach south of [[Hosidius]], [[Crabclaw Isle]], [[Crabclaw Caves]], beach on the [[Avium Savannah]]
|combat = 15
|hitpoints = 60
|requirements = 10,000 coins to enter [[Crabclaw Isle]], or have started [[The Depths of Despair]] to enter the [[Crabclaw Caves]]. There are also spots with no requirements
|recommendations = Armour and food for low levels. If you are farming on the beach south of Hosidius, there is a bank chest nearby so inventory space is not a concern. Using a full inventory of [[super attack]] and [[super strength]] potions increases your DPS considerably, which ultimately increases the experience rates per hour. The spots on the Avium Savannah are also significantly less congested, so may be preferable.
|advantages = * Very high health targets with low [[Defence]] and [[Attack]] ability
*High in number, easy to group and kill in groups
*Automatic aggro, meaning there are many AFK spots
|disadvantages = * Often very crowded in Hosidius, but not the Avium Savannah
*Stops aggro after about 10 minutes, must be reset by walking about one screen away
}}
